assertions.assertion: Uses context.Caller to differentiate between token types
assertions.rationale: Branches on context.Caller to differentiate identity vs access token claim sets.

assertions.assertion: Emits a minimal claim set (e.g. just name) for identity tokens
assertions.rationale: Identity-token branch adds only a single name claim.

assertions.assertion: Emits a richer claim set for access tokens, using AddRequestedClaims for scope filtering
assertions.rationale: The richer access-token branch uses context.IssuedClaims.AddRange, not AddRequestedClaims, so it does not apply scope filtering.
